title: Northstar — security review
description: Security-conscious buyer. Wants data residency answers and a DPA before any rollout.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Hi Marcus — you mentioned legal blocked the last notetaker. What do they need this time?

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: We cannot put PHI into a mystery cloud. Audio can leave the laptop only if we pick the API.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Understood. You bring your own PyAI key, and nothing else leaves your environment.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: We also need a signed DPA and confirmation that transcripts are not used for model training.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: I can send the DPA today and a one-pager on zero-training for customer audio.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: If that clears, we'll pilot with the compliance team — not sales — for two weeks.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Happy to start with compliance. Success looks like redacted notes with receipts they approve.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Next step: get the DPA to our counsel by Thursday. If they greenlight, we schedule onboarding.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: I'll email counsel, copy you, and attach the architecture diagram with data flows.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Intent is to standardize on one stack before our HIPAA audit in September.

followUpEmail.subject: Northstar: DPA, zero-training proof, and compliance pilot plan
followUpEmail.body:
Marcus —

Thanks for walking through the security requirements.

As promised, attaching:
1) DPA for counsel review
2) Zero-training one-pager for customer audio/transcripts
3) Architecture + data-flow diagram

Proposed success criteria for the two-week compliance pilot: redacted deal notes with transcript receipts your team can approve.

If counsel greenlights by Thursday, we can schedule onboarding immediately.

— OpenGong Lite
